cohort: The study included 100 healthy infants followed from 4 weeks to 12 months of age.
finding: Oral Candida prevalence ranged from 11% to 15% in the first year of life, was fairly stable until 6 months, and was lower in infants with a furry pet at 3 months, higher in those with older siblings at 12 months, and negatively associated with breastmilk lactoferrin at 6 months.
mod_finding: No conclusive impact of delivery mode on oral Candida colonisation was found.
